title: Art. 14
content:
**ELI ID:** `BR.L12527.C3.Art.14`
**Norm type:** right | **Direction:** permissive | **Scope:** administrative

> Art. 14. E direito do requerente obter o inteiro teor de decisao de negativa de acesso, por certidao ou copia.

**Relevance for LA-8159:** Prevents agencies from hiding behind summary denial notices; the requester can demand the full decision text.
